question: T12 (task-29c5c1878048849f, task-fe3aee94db3697be, task-daf891d36d64aacf, task-48d33619e462ed30): the rows while a Wave Intensity drag is held, Cmd+Z while it is held, and blocks below a desktop growth. On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan with a new Scrolling block and a Text block added after it (W: two), made on the desktop (desktop 1/2/3/26 and 1/2/3/10, phone 1/2/3/10 and 3/2/5/10). Mobile View (the frame 428 wide, then back to Desktop View) for H, I and V. Select the Scrolling block, Edit, Design, the presses on Wave Intensity (179 is the press at the range's end, read as 180), then a real drag through one DevTools session: a press on the range at its first value, a move to each next value gap ms apart, and quick reads in that same session (layout and state, by the page's clock: 'held <n> <value> +<ms>' is a read that many ms after the n-th move, each taking about 0.1 to 0.2 s more; 'up +<ms>' after the let go). H: 90 pressed, a drag 90>120>150>180>150>120>90 at 300 ms, reads 80 ms after each move and 80, 400, 1200 and 2500 ms after the last, let go on 90. I: 90 pressed, a drag 90>120>150>180>150>120 at 1500 ms, reads 80 and 1200 ms after each move, let go on 120. U (desktop) and V (phone): 90 pressed, a drag 90>120>150 at 300 ms; 300 ms after the last move a real Cmd+Z while the pointer is still held, reads 80 and 800 ms after it, then the let go on 150 and reads. W (desktop): the Text blocks placed at 6/2/8/10 and 8/2/10/10, then a drag from 0, 0>30>60>90>120>150>180 at 300 ms, a read after each move, let go on 180. X and Y (desktop): the Text block placed at 6/2/8/10 (X) or 8/2/10/10 (Y), then presses 90 and 180. Then Escape (let go, 'go') and Cmd+Z ('Z', only while the section is not back as built), a read after each. R1 ran HIUVWXY, R2 YXWVUIH, two edit sessions. Nothing saved: every session left by Exit Without Saving.
readsAre: As CAP-T12DRAGEND: layout of the Scrolling block and every block in its section (me: the Scrolling block; line: its drawing's height; sel: selected; kind; desktop and phone areas, top in the section and height), the section rows in the view shown, the Scrolling block's height, line (marquee and svg: top in the block and height), Undo and Redo, the panel's ranges; 'wave' is the panel's Wave Intensity value. 'inputs' holds each drag's quick reads (states: [name, { t: the page's clock, L: the layout as in reads, st: value, focus, Undo/Redo, selected blocks, lines }]), its input, change and pointer events by the page's clock from the press (log) and the press's own clock (t0). The read's name is the run, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them ('Z' is Cmd+Z).
answer: H: in the phone view, held, each value of a drag takes the rows a press to it would, the fall's too, at once: 90 pressed (1/2/5/10), a drag at 300 ms shows 1/2/6/10, 1/2/7/10 and 1/2/8/10 on the way out, then 1/2/6/10 at 150, 1/2/6/10 at 120 and 1/2/4/10 at 90 on the way back (the Text block on its foot, 5 to 9 rows), each read within 0.25 s of its move. 90 stays 1/2/4/10 held 0.4, 1.2 and 2.5 s, and after the let go (no change event fires); Escape keeps it; Cmd+Z gives back 1/2/5/10, the next the section as built.

I: the same slow, 1500 ms a value: held 150 on the way back is 1/2/6/10 80 ms and 1.2 s after its move, 120 1/2/6/10, and the let go on 120 (a change event fires) keeps 1/2/6/10. Cmd+Z goes back one value a step, 150 at 1/2/7/10, 180 at 1/2/8/10, 150 at 1/2/7/10, 120 at 1/2/6/10, 90 at 1/2/5/10, then the section as built, as CAP-T12DRAGEND F.

U (desktop) and V (phone): Cmd+Z while a drag 90>120>150 is held takes back the drag so far, not the press: the value goes to 90 and the rows to the press's (desktop 1/2/5/26 with the Text block at 3/2/5/10; phone 1/2/5/10 with it at 5/2/7/10), Undo and Redo both on, the range keeps the focus. The let go after it (on 150's place) fires no change and takes no step: the same rows, Undo and Redo on. After Escape one Cmd+Z gives the section as built.

W (desktop): Text blocks at 6/2/8/10 and 8/2/10/10, a drag from 0 out to 180: every growth takes both down by the foot's change, though the foot never reaches them: 60 (foot 4) 7/2/9/10 and 9/2/11/10, 90 (foot 5) 8 and 10, 120 the same, 150 (foot 6) 9 and 11, 180 (foot 7) 10/2/12/10 and 12/2/14/10, the section 13 rows; the let go (a change fires) keeps it; Cmd+Z gives back the placed blocks.

X and Y (desktop): a press growth takes a Text block below down by the foot's change though the new foot does not reach it: from 6/2/8/10 90 (foot 5) leaves 8/2/10/10 and 180 (foot 7) 10/2/12/10; from 8/2/10/10 10/2/12/10 and 12/2/14/10. Cmd+Z one press a step.

R1 and R2 read alike in all reads they share, Undo and Redo at a plan's start apart (Redo stays on from the plan before). Not read: a touch drag held; Cmd+Z held in a drag with a step taken by a pause; Redo after it; a desktop drag's growth after a fall with two blocks below.
